map.按年龄与体重身高估算体表面积：成人用 DuBois 式，儿童/婴幼儿用 Hayc: Estimate body surface area from weight, height and age: the DuBois equation for adults and the Haycock equation for children under 18 (blank age falls back to adult), used to size chemotherapy doses, burn fluid plans and paediatric drug dosing.
map.成人（年龄 ≥18 或留空）：DuBois 式 BSA = 0.007184 ×: Adults (age ≥18 or blank): DuBois BSA = 0.007184 × weight (kg)^0.425 × height (cm)^0.725 (m², 3 decimals). Children and infants (age <18): Haycock BSA = 0.024265 × weight (kg)^0.5378 × height (cm)^0.3964 (m²). Validation: weight and height are required valid numbers, age is optional (negative values rejected); age selects the formula, and a blank age is treated as adult. Interpretation: there are no fixed grades and this page only uses these two formulas; BSA grows with weight and height, and the result is an estimate for chemotherapy/prescribing that must be verified against the protocol and by a pharmacist.

map.算法：成人（年龄 ≥18 或留空）用 DuBois：BSA = 0.007184: Algorithm: adults (age ≥18 or blank) use DuBois: BSA = 0.007184 × weight (kg)^0.425 × height (cm)^0.725; children and infants (age <18) use Haycock: BSA = 0.024265 × weight (kg)^0.5378 × height (cm)^0.3964, in m². Weight and height must be >0; age is optional (blank means adult).
map.⚠ 1 岁以下婴幼儿体表面积估算误差较大，化疗剂量须由药师按方案核定。: ⚠ Body-surface-area estimates are less accurate for infants under 1 year; chemotherapy doses must be verified by a pharmacist against the protocol.
map.许多药物清除率与体表面积更相关，按 BSA 给药可减少胖瘦个体差异、提高治疗指数: Many drugs' clearance correlates better with body surface area, so dosing by BSA reduces individual differences between thin and heavy patients and improves the therapeutic index; the simplified Mosteller formula √(weight × height / 3600) can also be used.
map.DuBois 对普通成人较好，本页儿童/婴幼儿（＜18 岁）自动改用 Hayco: DuBois works well for ordinary adults, and this page automatically switches to Haycock for children and infants (under 18); the error still grows with obesity or extreme body types, and chemotherapy doses must be verified against the protocol and by a pharmacist.

map.算法（DuBois）：BSA = 0.007184 × 体重(kg)^0.425: Algorithm (DuBois): BSA = 0.007184 × weight (kg)^0.425 × height (cm)^0.725, in m². Weight and height must be >0.
map.DuBois 对普通成人较好；肥胖或儿童需专用公式（如 Haycock），极端体: DuBois works well for ordinary adults; obese patients or children need dedicated formulas (such as Haycock), and the error grows with extreme body types.
